historicalPathAudit.method: git log --follow --name-status on package.json, src/index.ts, and src/repositories/repo-links.ts
historicalPathAudit.detail: git log --follow reported a content-similarity match against packages/content-core/package.json at commit cfaeb71 and its descendants, but packages/content-core is a distinct, still-existing sibling package (@ravenhill/content-core, 'Content abstraction layer for reusable documentation and learning systems'). git show --name-status -M on the actual introducing commit (76228da) shows every packages/site-core/** file as a pure add (A), not a rename (R). This was a --follow false positive, not a real historical rename; it was not included in the extraction path set.

extraction.cloneMethod: git clone --no-local --single-branch --branch dev/qa --no-tags <local source path> <fresh clone dir>, then the clone's dev/qa (and origin/dev/qa tracking ref) were reset to the freeze commit before filtering so that only freeze-commit-and-earlier history was rewritten; performed outside the ordinary DIBS working copy.
